dataset.name: Elliptic local93
dataset.scope: exploratory refinement on previously exposed test

exposure.threat_model: recipient1; shared model/scaler, own train-period shadow features; known-membership auxiliary examples for membership
exposure.exposure: actual routed first-layer states and source IDs; model state known; no remote raw graph/features supplied to attack predictor
exposure.membership_definition: label used in supervised loss; all graph nodes remain visible
exposure.matching: same train period; class,owner,timestep,in-degree bucket balanced before auxiliary/evaluation split
exposure.limitations: one victim/draw; frozen inference representations only; repeated training-round/adaptive/update attacks untested; temporal shift remains in reconstruction; finite auxiliary attacks are not comprehensive; failure is not privacy

transport.placement: GTX CUDA source-state preparation; RTX CUDA receiver; three logical owners/two hosts
transport.protocol: mutual TLS1.3 over Tailscale, safe numeric framing and authenticated owner/context
transport.operation: snapshot inference routing; source states prepared on GTX before measurement; no transported training rounds
transport.application_bytes_statistic: median of30steady observations; JSON round/sequence digit length can vary
transport.byte_scope: numeric arrays, routing IDs and envelopes; excludes TLS/TCP/IP/Tailscale framing and initial staging
